messages:
Maria (People Ops): Heads-up — need an exception for candidate Priya Shah (SWE-2). Offer was approved in band B3 but candidate's requested start is 4/1, payroll says band exceptions need director signoff for <30-day notice. Can we route? Details: base $150k, sign-on $10k, start 2026-04-01.
Jamal (Recruiter): Reposting packet, she accepted verbally today at 09:15. We promised 4/1 start to accommodate relocation. :slightly_smiling_face:
Tina (Hiring Manager): Wow that's tight. We need her in the week of 4/6 ideally, but 4/1 works. Is the director available to sign today?
Alex (Compensation): I see the file — band B3, above midpoint. Standard policy says exceptions > 10% of band or < 30-day start require director. % over midpoint is ~12%. So director approval needed.
Maria (People Ops): Can we do expedited routing? Jamal can attach signed offer, relocation docs.
Jamal (Recruiter): Uploaded: `offer_priya_shah_signed.pdf`, `relocation_request.pdf` — here's the link: https://files.redwood.example/priya_offer
HireBot (automated): Reminder: comp-exception form not completed. Use `/comp-exception submit` to start approval workflow.
Jamal (Recruiter): Submitted comp-exception via slash command just now. Workflow ID: CE-2026-0423-19
Alex (Compensation): I'll review and prep rationale. If we push to director, note the business case: high priority project, scarce candidate, relocation required. Add the hiring scorecard.
Tina (Hiring Manager): Adding: candidate has critical infra experience, ramps faster. :thumbsup:
Maria (People Ops): @Sarah (Director of Comp) can you review CE-2026-0423-19? We need decision by EOD to keep 4/1 start.
Sarah (Director of Comp): I can sign off if hiring manager confirms no remote-first start. Also need assurance relocation approved and start-related costs capped. Will sign after docs confirmed.
Tina (Hiring Manager): Confirmed — relocation approved and capped at $8k; remaining covered by candidate. No remote-first caveats.
Alex (Compensation): I've updated the comp-exception form to reflect $8k cap and business justification.
Sarah (Director of Comp): Signed. CE-2026-0423-19 — approved at 15:42. :white_check_mark:
Maria (People Ops): Awesome — Jamal, proceed with finalized offer and startdate 2026-04-01. Update payroll and onboarding timeline.
Jamal (Recruiter): Sending final docs to candidate now. Onboarding kickoff scheduled for 3/30 remote, in-person 4/1. Thanks everyone!
Maria (People Ops): Marking thread closed once payroll confirms. :party_parrot:
